hypothesis: Among seasoned liquid spot cryptocurrencies, lower ex-ante realized volatility may carry a persistent long-side premium over multi-week horizons; test it independently from momentum families.
universe_rule: Top 80 current Binance Spot USDT symbols excluding stable/fiat-like bases, leveraged tokens, wrapped/gold proxies and reserved holdout. Causal signal-time eligibility: >=365 days prior 4h history and >=10M USDT average daily quote volume over prior 30 days.
market_regime: BTC close > EMA600 and BTC 30d return > 0

LOWVOL_MOM_INTERACTION.filter: bottom 25% realized volatility then positive 30d momentum

rule: No parameter changes after results. Do not test final holdout unless discovery passes.
